race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
race.verdict: Hard to get a handle on the newcomers before market clues so RIA'S ANGEL gets the vote having taken a big step forward when not beaten far in fourth over 7f here 3 weeks ago. Joseph O'Brien's Kodiak Gold and Thosegirlsdontplay make plenty of appeal on paper. RIA'S ANGEL (IRE) KODIAK GOLD (IRE) THOSEGIRLSDONTPLAY (IRE)
